clue.text: Labour gets some inducement here

parts.note: labour means work
a sop is something offered to placate or induce

explanation.surface: The workforce is offered a small sweetener.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'here': the whole clue describes a place. WORKSOP is a market town in Nottinghamshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue points to a town, so 'here' stands for the place named, a Nottinghamshire town.

clue.text: Sovereign entitlement may be expressed in words

indicators.note: expressed suggests the letters are squeezed out and set into a new form

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A monarch's title might be spelt out verbally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expressed' rearranges the letters of IN WORDS. WINDSOR is the surname of the British royal house, so the monarch's family name.
explanation.definitionFit: The British royal family has held the house name Windsor since 1917, the title the sovereign goes by.

clue.text: Flora was promoted on call-up

parts.note: was promoted means rose in rank

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for call is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to call someone something is to dub them

explanation.surface: A woman called Flora got promotion after being called up for service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flora' looks like a woman's name but is the definition, plant life. 'up' turns DUB into BUD.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosebud is a young flower, an example of the plant life called flora.

clue.text: An expedient move

definitions.meaning: to ... something is to move it

explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a stratagem or makeshift resort, and the verb means to change position.

clue.text: A beast long retaining gold cup

indicators.note: retaining means the word for long holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: to long for is to pine
OR is gold in heraldry
taken as written

explanation.surface: An animal that keeps hold of a golden trophy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long' looks like a measure of size but is the verb, to yearn; 'retaining' is the container signal and 'gold' is heraldic OR.
explanation.definitionFit: The porcupine is a quilled rodent, an example of a wild animal.

clue.text: Studies made of exercise devices

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
devices here are tricks or ruses

explanation.surface: Research built from gym equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: To peruse is to read carefully, the same sense as studies as a verb.

clue.text: The capital is under par

indicators.note: in a down clue, under means the second piece sits beneath the first

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: The capital is not up to standard.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'under' puts IS below PAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Paris is the capital city of France.

clue.text: Person paying homage to sceptre representing the queen

indicators.note: representing suggests the letters are presented again in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the queen

explanation.surface: A loyal subject bows to the royal sceptre as a symbol of the queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'representing' rearranges SCEPTRE into RESPECT; ER (Elizabeth Regina) is a crossword convention for the queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A respecter is one who shows deference or honour, as one paying homage does.

clue.text: Fruit will be the making of her!

definitions.meaning: a dried grape, a raisin-like fruit

definitions.text: will be the making of her!
definitions.meaning: marrying a sultan turns a woman into his wife with this title

explanation.surface: Some fruit will transform her life.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a pale seedless dried grape and the title of a sultan's wife, which a woman becomes on marriage.

clue.text: Put away in case it causes agitation in some woman

indicators.note: in places the word for agitation within the word for some woman

parts.note: she is any female person
heat means excitement or agitation

explanation.surface: Keep it covered in case it upsets a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'in' belongs to the definition 'Put away in case'; the second is the container signal. 'agitation' is heat in the sense of excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: To sheathe a blade is to store it in its scabbard, a protective cover.

clue.text: A good man put in control turned less pleasant

indicators.note: put in says the first pieces go inside the word for control
turned means the word for control is read backwards

parts.note: a rein is a means of control
ST, saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: Someone given authority became meaner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' makes NIER of the word for control, and 'put in' is the container signal. ST, saint, is the crossword's standard good man.
explanation.definitionFit: Nastier is the comparative of nasty, meaning more disagreeable.

clue.text: Determination is needed to work out yet again

parts.note: the prefix re- means again, so yet again gives these two letters
to work out a puzzle is to solve it

explanation.surface: It takes willpower to keep solving a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolve is firmness of purpose, a synonym of determination.

clue.text: They do harm a boss, true!

definitions.text: They do harm a boss, true!

indicators.note: doing harm to these letters wrecks them into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Wreckers really do harm to an employer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do harm' rearranges the letters of A BOSS TRUE; the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Saboteurs deliberately damage or obstruct, as wreckers of a manager's plans would.

clue.text: Right to insist upon

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means precisely correct; as a verb it means to demand and obtain something.

clue.text: Equestrian comment made in court

definitions.meaning: a jury may add a recommendation or comment to its verdict

explanation.definitionFit: A rider sits on a horse; a rider is also an added recommendation attached to a jury's verdict.

clue.text: Flavouring agent for cool amber brew

indicators.note: brew suggests the letters are stirred together into something new

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A seasoning for a chilled golden beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brew' rearranges the letters of COOL AMBER.
explanation.definitionFit: Rocambole is a garlic-like plant, sand leek, used to season food.

clue.text: Uncertain — for the Italian left a torment

parts.note: il is the Italian for the
taken as written
to tease is to torment

explanation.surface: An Italian man leaves behind him a torment.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ill at ease means uncomfortable and unsure of oneself.

clue.text: After aid on the side

parts.note: after means later
an ally is a helper or aid

explanation.surface: Help comes later, from the sidelines.
explanation.definitionFit: Laterally means sideways, towards or from a flank.

clue.text: The awful creep isn't far-seeing

indicators.note: awful suggests the letters are in a dreadful jumble

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe giving no letter

explanation.surface: That horrid sneak is no visionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' rearranges the letters of CREEP ISNT.
explanation.definitionFit: Prescient means having foreknowledge, knowing what will happen.

clue.text: Have certain law-men go over the ship

indicators.note: in a down clue, go over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: posses are groups of men enlisted by a sheriff to enforce the law
SS is steamship

explanation.surface: Some sheriffs board a vessel to inspect it.
explanation.walkthrough: A posse is a band summoned by a sheriff in the Old West; SS prefixes a steamship's name.
explanation.definitionFit: To possess is to own or hold, the same as have.

clue.text: Note calls about money required for paints

parts.note: E is a musical note

indicators.note: about means the word for calls wraps round the money letter

parts.note: to call someone something is to name them
L stands for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A memo says funds are needed for decorating.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamels are glossy coatings, a type of paint.

clue.text: Taking some care because it's an old instrument

indicators.note: Taking some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Handle this carefully, as it is an antique instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The rebec was a medieval bowed stringed instrument, a forerunner of the fiddle.

clue.text: William backed up no-one a lot

parts.note: Bill is short for William

indicators.note: in a down clue, backed up means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: no gives NO and one gives I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: William reversed and supported nobody much.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed up' turns NOI (NO plus I for one) into ION.
explanation.definitionFit: A billion is a huge number, used loosely for a great many.

clue.text: Claim against minister

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
to minister to someone is to tend them

explanation.surface: A protest against a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: To contend is to assert or maintain, as in a claim.

clue.text: Army sergeant major going about his business

indicators.note: going about means the sergeant major letters surround the other piece

parts.note: a soldier's business is war

explanation.surface: A senior soldier goes about his daily duties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his business' is war, a soldier's trade; 'going about' puts it inside SM.
explanation.definitionFit: Army here means a large crowd, as in a swarm of insects or people.

clue.text: Rating a missionary wearing weatherproof stuff

parts.note: a rating is an ordinary sailor, a tar
St Paul was the great missionary of the early church
wearing something means being in it

explanation.surface: A sailor and a missionary both dressed in oilskins.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarpaulin is waterproofed canvas used as a protective covering.

clue.text: Taking the pink paper?

parts.note: taken as written
the Financial Times is printed on pink paper

explanation.surface: Picking up the salmon-coloured newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: The FT, the Financial Times, is the British business daily known for its pink pages.
explanation.definitionFit: Theft is stealing, the act of taking what is not yours.

clue.text: Soon keeping company with a girl

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon

explanation.surface: Before long he will be seeing a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Anona is a girl's first name.

clue.text: Regards a mineral as a most undesirable thing

parts.note: to regard is to look at, to eye
ore is mineral rock

explanation.surface: Considers a rock to be quite unwelcome.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyesore is something ugly to look at, a blot on the landscape.

clue.text: Lion-hearted, though for ages kept in line

indicators.note: kept in means the word for ages is held inside the other word

parts.note: taken as written
an eon is an age, a very long time

explanation.surface: Brave, though made to queue for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonine means lion-like, so brave as a lion.

clue.text: States small page being accepted by school is questionable

indicators.note: being accepted by means the first pieces are taken inside the word for school

parts.note: a school of thought is a sect
US is the United States
P is the abbreviation for page

explanation.surface: A dubious claim that a young page was admitted to a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being accepted by' is the container signal: the States and the page letter go in just after the school word's first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspect as an adjective means doubtful or open to question.

clue.text: Longed for time to take wildlife refuge over

parts.note: a year is a period of time

indicators.note: over means the word for wildlife refuge is turned round

parts.note: a den is an animal's lair

explanation.surface: Wished it were time to visit a nature reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn is to long for something.
